metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.0 · 2019 · The Wishmas Tree
metas.description: A young possum's misguided wish for a white Wishmas freezes her entire hometown of Sanctuary City and threatens all who live there.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.1 · 2020 · Combat Wombat
metas.description: Maggie Diggins, a wombat turned Wonder Woman, unintentionally becomes the city's superhero after she begrudgingly saves a rookie superhero sugar glider from certain doom.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.5 · 2020 · Daisy Quokka: World's Scariest Animal
metas.description: An unbearably adorable, eternally optimistic Quokka named Daisy has an impossible dream - to win the 'World's Scariest Games'.
